explanation: I found no single Mathlib declaration that states this result. Mathlib has `AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian` (`Module.Flat R (AdicCompletion I R)`, in RingTheory/AdicCompletion/AsTensorProduct.lean). It also has `RingHom.Flat.comp`, `RingHom.Flat.of_bijective` and `RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff` (RingTheory/RingHom/Flat.lean). None of these gives flatness of the composite of the completion map with a ring equivalence. The theorem's proof combines three of them, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of a single declaration. My searches covered Flat, `RingHom.Flat` and AdicCompletion declarations in Mathlib.
